body:
Refreshed with #1141 (1b230423, which carries main c6597a76 and #1131 ed6a1eb4) and #1136 (e905c004). Neither merge had a textual conflict. Two literal fixes were needed: `crates/ui/tests/sinker_setup.rs`'s electrode takes `turning: None` (main's new `Tool` field), and the `posted_gates` sinker judge states `pass: Single, cavity_x/y: 0` (#1136's `SinkerBurnOp` fields). PROCESS_VERSION is 28, the same as #1141. Head 793708f6.

Tests: ui `sinker_setup` 1/1, ui lib `sinker_machine` 6/6, app `solid_law_goldens` 5/5, `sinker_burn` 10/10. Clippy on app and ui with `-D warnings` is clean.

**Still conflicting with main b7d3512e, so I stopped** (same hunk as #1141): #1116 moved `op_icon` into `op_icons.rs` and requires each `OpType` to have its own SVG-mastered `op-*` glyph. The stack's `SinkerBurn => Icon::Drill` breaks that law. The glyph belongs in #1131; once #1131 has it, this PR merges #1141 and then main.

Merged #1141's renumber (99bf379f): PROCESS_VERSION is now 31, the same as #1141. Head 50c1c803. The version file is the only change. The PR still conflicts with main over the SinkerBurn glyph, as in my comment above.

Refreshed with the refreshed #1141 (34bb4413), #1136 (18dcf446, which already carries #1131 50e395e8) and upstream/main (6a10c5ad). All three merged cleanly. Head 26b3d962.

What changed:
- The Machine window's EDM section now follows #560's condition rules. `problems()` judges each condition with the loader's own `condition_refusal` (now public in `post::machine`, next to `condition_id_key`), so the page names the rule Apply would hit, in the loader's words: the id is a word with no surrounding spaces, gap > 0, and undersize is in (0, 1] mm. Ids are compared the way the loader compares them, ignoring case and leading zeros ("S1"/"s1" and "01"/"1" are one selector). A wire-only `wire_diameter` on a sinker condition is also named.
- Ticking a condition's gap or undersize now seeds 0.01 mm or 0.1 mm, values the loader accepts. It used to seed 0, which the new law refuses.
- "Add condition" skips ids that collide under the loader's key.
- Pin: `sinker_machine_tests::problems_name_each_law_the_loader_keeps` was extended. For every new rule (gap 0, undersize 0 and 1.5, case and leading-zero id collisions, a spaced id, an empty id) it asserts that the page names the problem and that `Edm::is_sane` refuses it. For the wire field it asserts that `Machine::edm_sane` refuses it. It also checks that the seeds pass both.
- PROCESS_VERSION 31, carried from #1141.

Tests: ui `sinker_setup` 1/1, ui lib `sinker_machine` 6/6 (`sinker` filter 9/9), app `solid_law_goldens` 5, `sinker_burn` 10, `edm_conditions` 1, `edm_machine` 5, post lib 38, all green. `clippy -D warnings` is clean on post, app and ui (all targets). Still a draft.

Refreshed with #1141 ab339b70 (59f100dc): merged the refreshed #1141 (which carries #1131 5fc71cf2). One conflict, crates/app/tests/sinker_burn.rs: took #1131's tests/edm/sinker_fixture.rs module in place of the in-file helpers; the fixture's burn() gains #543's SinkerBurnOp fields (pass Single, cavity_x/y 0) as the in-file helper had. One follow-up commit: #1131's lib fixture stock_sim_held_tests.rs names #543's new SinkerParams.stand as None (one spark gap stop, as the golden test does). #1136 still at 18dcf446 (already in); upstream/main already contained; PROCESS_VERSION stays 31. Tests: sinker_burn 10/10, sinker_burn_held 6/6, sinker_undersize 5/5, solid_law_goldens 5/5, app lib stock_sim_held 2/2, ui sinker_setup 1/1, ui lib sinker_machine 6/6, clippy -D warnings (app, ui, all targets) clean.

This conflicts with main: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` and `crates/post/tests/recorded/mod.rs`. Please merge upstream/main and push. For the mod.rs list keep both sides; for PROCESS_VERSION main currently reads 26 - take the next free number when you merge (27 and 28 are earmarked for PRs #972/#1033 which are re-merging right now; PRs #1086/#1127/#1138/#1161/#1179 have claimed the earlier ones). GitHub's mergeable is the authority, so a local-only PROCESS_VERSION clash after that merge is fine.

Taken for the refresh (SKULL, mkinney fork agent): #1131 has merged, so SKULL is merging main into #1141, then #1165 onto the refreshed #1141, per the maintainer's ask. Other sessions: please leave this PR alone until SKULL's 'ready for review' comment.

Refreshed on main (author side, not a review) - ready for review

Head `cbcea617` = merge of upstream/main (dda16848) into 59f100dc, plus two follow-up commits. No rebase, no force-push. Main's reworked #1141 supersedes the old #1141 head (ab339b70) this PR carried; `git diff upstream/main --stat` now lists only #548's 10 files (post `machine/{edm,edm_conditions,mod}.rs`, ui `machine_editor.rs`, `machine_edm_editor.rs`, `egui_app/mod.rs`, `sinker_machine_tests.rs`, `sinker_page.rs`, `tests/sinker_setup.rs`, `docs/decisions/548-sinker-ui.md`).

**Resolutions**
- `app/src/stock_sim_held_tests.rs`, `app/tests/edm/sinker_fixture.rs`, `app/tests/posted_gates/mod.rs`: took main's version (it already has the orbit, layer and wear literal fields).
- `post/src/machine/mod.rs`: main's re-exports (incl. `wear_rate_ok`), plus this PR's `condition_refusal`, `condition_id_key` and `SINKER_CODES` re-exports. Main's `edm_codes` module is unchanged.
- `ui/egui_app/mod.rs`: both modules are kept (main's wire `machine_edm`, this PR's `machine_edm_editor`).
- `ui/egui_app/machine_editor.rs`: took main's scrolling layout. A sinker EDM now draws its own section plus axes, in place of spindle, tooling and coolant. This matches how main draws a wire EDM, and `Machine::edm_sane` refuses those rows on an EDM anyway.

**Adapted to main (this PR's code over main's API)**
- The sinker section edits `Machine::edm_codes`, since main moved the codes off `Edm`. `problems()` now takes the codes map.
- The condition readout row on the op page is renamed "Electrode undersize" -> "Condition undersize". Main's Side Burn already has "Electrode undersize" on Passes, and `every_registry_kind_gets_its_tab_bar` allows one tab per label. No rows from main were duplicated: main's wear, orbit and side-burn rows are untouched.
- The tests scroll Apply into reach before clicking it (`scroll_to_me` + `run_steps`), as main's wire tests do.
- `tests/sinker_setup.rs`: its literals now include main's new `Tool` fields (`pitch_min`, `catalog`, `cutting`) and `SinkerBurnOp` fields.
- The decision file records the layout change.

Took main's snapshot PNGs, CHANGELOG, RECOMMENDED and PROCESS_VERSION. This PR touches no process file.

**Mutation check** (each refusal this PR adds was deleted, then the test run: RED; restored: GREEN)
- `Edm::is_sane` blank-pickup rule (post `edm.rs`): RED (`problems_name_each_law_the_loader_keeps`, "a blank pickup is refused at Apply").
- The page's `problems()` lines:
  - max orbit radius: GREEN at first. A new case was added to the test, after which it is RED.
  - orbit with no word: RED.
  - condition with no id: RED.
  - `condition_refusal` passthrough: RED.
  - wire diameter on a sinker: RED.
  - id stated twice: RED.
  - one selector: RED.
  - blank code: RED. A blank-code-alone case was also added, checked against `Machine::is_sane`.
  - blank pickup: RED.
- All restored: GREEN.

**Tests on the final head**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: post 10 suites, app 45 suites, ui lib + `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `sinker_setup`, `theme_files`. All ok. The ui lib, `structural` included, ran 690 tests and all passed.
- app `sinker_burn` 14, `sinker_burn_held` 7, `sinker_electrode` 8, `sinker_electrode_mcp` 1, `sinker_orbit` 7, `sinker_side` 6, `sinker_undersize` 7, `sinker_wear` 6, `edm_machine` 5, `edm_conditions` 2, `operations` 119, `project_roundtrip` 73. All ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Not exercised**
- The sinker section shows no condition wear-rate field (main's `wear_rate_ok`). Main's wire section has none either, and a loaded rate passes through unchanged.
- No hand check on a real EDM control.

<!-- pr-reviewer: cbcea6173b0d1582ee6403336d26e98f06248dbc -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Layering holds: the new UI file imports only `camcraft_app::machine` / `units`; no raw Flecs. The page reads the mounted machine through `machine::of_setup`.
- Every edit is a change to the machine draft and goes through the existing undoable `EditMachineApply` (one Apply = one undo step), validated at command creation by `Machine::is_sane`; `problems()` words the same laws beside the section.
- Main's sinker refusals (tip, plunge, undersize, wear) are untouched. The only law change is `Edm::is_sane` refusing a blank `pickup`, which the file loader already did.
- `condition_refusal` and `id_key` are exposed from post instead of duplicated, so the page and the loader cannot drift. No new Cargo dependency, no process files, no snapshot PNG changed.
- No new command, so no new MCP tool; the follow-up is named (#1162). Decision file `docs/decisions/548-sinker-ui.md` present. New files are under 400 lines; provenance lines present. UI strings are plain English ("not stated", "Apply will refuse: ...").

**Local results (trial-merged with current main, clean merge)**
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` post suites (lib + 9 binaries incl. script_sinker_iso) | ok |
| app suites (machine, machine_edit, mcp_edit_machine, posting, sinker_wear, wire_post, ...) | ok |
| ui: lib 666 passed / 5 ignored (includes sinker_machine_tests), boundary, boundary_picks, sinker_setup, theme_files | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The three failures the body lists from the stacked parents are gone on current main.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Per the UI-PR rule, the body embeds no before/after screenshots of the Machine window section or the Sinker Burn page; the body also says the pages need the maintainer's hand check. Not exercised here (no GUI launched).
- `machine_editor.rs` is 355 lines, `egui_app/mod.rs` 381: close to the 400-line limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
